description: Unit tests for SearchModelFactory class, verifying creation of search results, filters, properties, queries, and sort options.

classes.name: SearchModelFactoryTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for SearchModelFactory class, testing search result creation, filter composition, property creation, and sorting options.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ThingsModelFactory class is immutable.

methods.name: newSearchResult
methods.description: Creates a new SearchResult with no items and no next page, then asserts its state.

methods.name: newSearchResultFromJson
methods.description: Constructs a SearchResult from a JsonObject with items and nextPageOffset, then verifies contents.

methods.name: newSearchResultFromJsonString
methods.description: Builds a SearchResult from a JSON string and verifies the contents and next page offset.

methods.name: newSearchResultEmpty
methods.description: Creates an empty SearchResult and asserts it has no next page and is empty.

methods.name: tryToCreateAndFilterWithNullFilter1
methods.description: Checks that passing null to SearchModelFactory.and() raises NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateAndFilterWithNullFilter2
methods.description: Checks that passing null as second filter to SearchModelFactory.and() raises NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateAndFilterWithNullOptionalFilters
methods.description: Ensures null in filters list passed to and() raises exception.

methods.name: createAndFilterWithMultipleFilters
methods.description: Creates a combined AND filter with multiple mock filters and verifies filter count.

methods.name: tryToCreateOrFilterWithNullFilter1
methods.description: Checks exception when null is passed as first argument to or().

methods.name: tryToCreateOrFilterWithNullFilter2
methods.description: Checks exception when null is passed as second argument to or().

methods.name: tryToCreateOrFilterWithNullOptionalFilters
methods.description: Checks exception when null included in filters passed to or().

methods.name: createOrFilterWithMultipleFilters
methods.description: Creates a logical OR filter with multiple mock filters and verifies filter count.

methods.name: tryToCreateNotFilterWithNullFilter
methods.description: Validates that passing null to not() raises NullPointerException.

methods.name: createNotFilter
methods.description: Creates a NOT filter wrapping a mock filter and verifies contained filters.

methods.name: tryToCreateSearchPropertyWithNullJsonPointer
methods.description: Checks that passing null as JsonPointer to property() raises exception.

methods.name: tryToCreateSearchPropertyWithNullString
methods.description: Checks that passing null string to property() raises exception.

methods.name: createSearchProperty
methods.description: Creates a SearchProperty with a specific JSON path and verifies it.

methods.name: tryToCreateSearchQueryWithNullFilter
methods.description: Ensures creating a search query with null filter raises exception.

methods.name: newSearchQueryReturnsExpected
methods.description: Creates a SearchQuery from a mock filter and verifies it's not null.

methods.name: newSortOptionFromSingleEntry
methods.description: Creates a SortOption from a property path and sort order, then verifies equality with expected.
